label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Black Desert Resort Expansion
items.text: Black Desert Resort is adding new courses, including potentially a Tiger Woods design, but questions whether hosting the PGA Tour is worth the cost.

items.headline: Niemann Weighs Tour Options
items.text: Joaquin Niemann urges the PGA Tour to 'open a door' for him as he considers returning amid LIV Golf's uncertain future and DP World Tour options.

items.headline: David Ford Returns Strong
items.text: After a painful foot injury that sidelined him nearly three months, David Ford finished T3 at the Bank of Utah Championship with a final-round 64, signaling his return to form.
